objective: Re-prove the plan-level M3 ContextCell boundary as enforced, versioned runtime truth over the post-ADR 0031 execution seam: immutable ContextCellRevision projections, Agentgres-receipt-backed ContextTransitionReceipt projections, exact ContextLease/ContextHandoff subjects, and deny-first cross-cell access; M8_CONTEXT_CELL_VERSION_LEASE_ENFORCEMENT_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: The claim fails if accepted context bytes cannot resolve an immutable content revision and canonical Agentgres predecessor/root evidence, if any context family independently mints sequence or receipt truth, if a lease names a reusable profile instead of a concrete cell or invocation, if another cell is readable without an exact lease, or if an offline verifier cannot reconstruct the accepted transition root from exported Agentgres evidence.
current_implementation_evidence: SHAPING EVIDENCE (owner ruling 2026-08-02): the manual multi-session orchestration practice now driving this very program is the first LIVED evidence for the ADR-0031 KEEP context vocabulary (ContextCell/ContextCellRevision, ContextLease, ContextHandoff, ContextTransitionReceipt; RoleTopology and OrchestrationPlan at their owners). Director, implementer, and reviewer cells boot from FILE cells: briefs are ContextHandoff, the delegation grid is a ContextLease, roles are a RoleTopology, batched STOP reports are an OrchestrationPlan, and the model ladder (which model runs which leg) is launch policy over the model-route registry. PORTABILITY INVARIANT: every cell MUST be projectable as plain files — files are the universal harness adapter with zero integration surface, and the outside precedent is per-person CLAUDE.md/agents.md/QM files. TRUTH-INVERSION RULE (ADR 0030 test): in the product end state cells ADMIT through Agentgres and the file projections are hash-bound, regenerable, and never the spine; today's pre-product manual practice runs files-as-truth, and the product flips it — a cell family that minted its own sequence/receipt/root would be the second-spine defect one layer up, which this record forbids. FALSIFIABLE PURPOSE CLAIM: curated fresh context + intent-blind review + durable cross-session accumulation + best-model-per-leg beats single-long-context frontier sessions; the M5 manual run is the experiment and a friction log is kept as measured input. Canon doctrine lands at this family's owner pass, NOT before; this field is shaping evidence, not an admitted contract.

in_scope: Post-ADR 0031 execution semantics: context cells bind exact daemon-owned thread, fork, managed-session, launch-recipe, and harness-session records rather than a GoalRun-local orchestration spine.

ContextCellRevision with cell id, content root, exact projection roots, lease/policy hashes, expiry, fork lineage, and references to the canonical Agentgres operation sequence and predecessor/root evidence; local revision numbers are derived API tokens only.

ContextTransitionReceipt is a typed projection over one canonical Agentgres operation and receipt, exposing expected head, previous/resulting roots, operation/body hash, actor, authority/lease refs, admission decision, and owner epoch without minting or owning any of them.
Exact lease enforcement at context read, write, handoff, compaction, subscription, terminal, secret, and invocation crossings.
Positive, cross-cell denial, stale-head, substitution, replay, restart, and offline-reconstruction evidence.
out_of_scope: General durable memory namespaces, memory promotion, and retrieval projections, owned by m8-product-memory-runtime-successor-and-scs-retirement.
General durable event subscriptions, owned by m5-agentgres-durable-event-subscription-successor.
M4 room truth and both M4 literals.
Creating this proposed record implements nothing and changes no predecessor status.
implementation_actions: Register the ContextCellRevision and ContextTransitionReceipt projection contracts before runtime implementation only after their no-parallel-admission rulings are represented in schema invariants.
Replace role-shaped context JSON and profile-subject leases with exact cell/invocation subjects and Agentgres expected-head admission.
Prove cross-cell denial and byte-for-byte offline reconstruction before generating the retained literal.

pre_schema_admission_ownership_rulings.ruling: This is an immutable content/version projection. It owns cell content and derived API revision tokens, but mints no sequence, predecessor commitment, decision, receipt, state root, receipt root, or transition chain; those fields resolve through exact canonical Agentgres operation and receipt refs.

Despite the vocabulary name, this is a typed evidence projection over one canonical Agentgres receipt and cannot be minted, persisted, or advanced independently. If schema review cannot make that single-owner invariant structural, rename the family before registration rather than create a second receipt plane.

This family expresses an exact data/resource access grant to a concrete cell or invocation. Its issue, attenuation, revocation, and consumption transitions reference their canonical authority and Agentgres evidence; the lease owns no admission spine and implies neither prim:* capability nor scope:* effect authority.
This family binds source and target cell revisions and authority refs. The accepted handoff is an Agentgres operation; the family mints no independent sequence, receipt, root, or transition chain.

contract_definition_of_done: Each family lands with a schema and invariants file, positive and negative fixtures, and a conformance owner that proves the named refusals.
Every cross-reference is declared authoritative or derived; no ambiguous bidirectional membership, version, lease, handoff, or lineage edge is accepted.
A registry entry alone is presence, not closure, and cannot satisfy this work item.
parallel_delivery_constraints: Target post-ADR 0031 thread/fork/session/harness semantics and sequence this implementation after m5-goalrun-thread-orchestration-seam.
Implement on a dedicated branch and reviewable PR separate from PR #133.
The mechanically generated M4 contract freeze must pass; this track may add families but may not change a frozen M4 registry entry, schema, invariant, or fixture while M4 is open.
Run canon-impact acceptance once at the end of the branch, with per-subject dispositions rather than blanket acceptance.
Regenerate architecture-contract-registry.v1.json with generate-architecture-contracts.mjs; never hand-merge registry conflicts.
consequential_effects_and_final_invokers: effect: accepted context transition | final_invoker: Agentgres operation admission | authority_source: exact technical capability plus ContextLease plus effect grant, none implying another | receipt_or_evidence: canonical Agentgres receipt plus ContextTransitionReceipt projection and exported operation/root evidence | negative_behavior: deny missing lease, wrong cell, stale head, mismatched content, independently minted receipt evidence, or unverified final invoker
positive_proof: One cell is created, revised, leased to one concrete invocation, handed off, replayed, and reconstructed from exported evidence without cross-cell visibility.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Cross-cell reads, profile-subject leases, stale heads, predecessor substitution, omitted projection roots, and offline reconstruction mismatch fail closed.
compatibility_and_migration: Existing unversioned role-shaped context JSON is historical input only and cannot satisfy the successor claim.
remaining_nonclaims: No general memory, pub/sub, sandbox, M4, or release claim.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Stop on any unversioned accepted context transition, reusable-profile lease subject, cross-cell read, or offline reconstruction mismatch.
